blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — ACT Teachers Rep. Antonio Tinio on Sunday accused the Marcos administration of using “desperate ploys” to quell protests against the US-led Pax Silica initiative and US President Donald Trump’s visit during the 49th Asean Summit. “Clearly rattled by the increasing number of Filipinos trooping to the streets, Malacañang is resorting to desperate ploys — fake news, intimidation, harassment, red-tagging, and threats of force — to quell the people’s protest,” Tinio, an opposition lawmaker, said in a statement. “The Marcos government must be reminded: rallies and protests are part and parcel of the constitutional rights to freedom of expression […]...
